latestVersion.changelog:
afrexai-construction-estimator 1.0.0

- Initial release of a comprehensive construction estimating and cost management system.
- Supports project estimating, bid proposals, cost breakdowns, value engineering, change order management, and budget tracking for residential, commercial, and infrastructure projects.
- Includes detailed templates and best practices for estimate classification, quantity takeoff (QTO), pricing, and labor cost build-up.
- Maps all estimates to CSI MasterFormat 2018 divisions for consistency.
- Provides quick-reference data for typical project types, unit costs, and industry benchmarks.
- Ready-to-use YAML templates for project briefs, line items, and cost assembly included.
